intro: The Silver Dawning's Lockbox is a sturdy chest resting within the sunken wreckage of the vessel Silver Dawning off the coast of Darkshore. It holds the personal effects and ship log of the vessel's fallen captain, lost during an ambush by coastal murlocs.

p: The ship Silver Dawning was en route across the sea toward the port of Auberdine when disaster struck. Coastal murlocs swarmed the vessel, driving it down into the dark surf north of the harbor. The captain perished in the assault, leaving the wreckage submerged beneath the waves as a grim monument claimed by the creatures. Inside the flooded hull remains the captain's personal lockbox, holding the ship's log and private belongings. Recovering these effects offers a final measure of peace to the surviving crew members ashore.
